subject: Prompt walkthrough & tier mapping — POC kickoff scheduling
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex@acme-analytics.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-analytics.com
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: POC kickoff — hands-on prompt walkthrough + routing tier mapping

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — the team is excited to move forward with a short POC. Our goals for the hands-on session are:
- Walk through a prompt review with 4 representative prompts (attached sample_prompts.csv)
- Define routing policy tiers (regional tiers, model tiering, and fallback rules)
- Run a short load test (simulated traffic) to confirm latency baselines

Can we lock a 3-hour working session the week of Nov 15? Prefer afternoons (US Eastern). We have product, infra, and procurement on standby but need confirmation on Redwood attendees (engineer + solutions).

Also attaching the sample prompt set used in production. Procurement is cc'd for contract/PO timing.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Moreno
Head of Product
Acme Analytics
attachments: sample_prompts.csv (CSV, 12kb)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — hands-on prompt walkthrough + routing tier mapping

Alex —

Appreciate the clear goals. We can own the engineering + ops side. Two proposed slots (3-hr blocks):
- Tue Nov 16, 13:00–16:00 ET
- Wed Nov 17, 14:00–17:00 ET

Attendees we suggest from our side: myself (sales/eng lead), Marissa (runtime engineer), Rishi (solutions/ops). Monica (customer success) can join the wrap-up.

Prework: please confirm the SLA/latency targets you care about and whether you want regional failover between us-east and eu-west. I've dropped a draft agenda in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-poc-acme.

I'll attach a short POC scope doc so procurement has context.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: POC_Scope_v2.pdf (PDF, 48kb)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Alex Moreno <alex@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 11:20:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — hands-on prompt walkthrough + routing tier mapping

Adding some engineering context —
- For the prompt walkthrough we recommend isolating 1 short-form and 1 long-form prompt to show latency differences at 512 vs 2048 tokens.
- Model availability: we can bring a quantized 7B variant and a 13B variant. If you have strict cost/latency constraints let us know and we can pre-select a tier mapping (fast/standard/backup).
- Load test: we can run a 15-minute synthetic run ahead of the live session (we typically do this ~48 hours prior). Need a target RPS and a representative token distribution.

If Tue Nov 16 or Wed Nov 17 work, please confirm timezone for all participants (I see some EU folks). Also indicate whether failover should target eu-west or apac as the secondary.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Staff SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Moreno <alex@acme-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — hands-on prompt walkthrough + tier mapping

Thanks Marissa and Jonas. Wed Nov 17 looks better for the product and infra leads. Can we set Wed Nov 17, 14:00–17:00 ET? Procurement has a competing review that morning.

We want failover to eu-west as the secondary and our latency target is 200ms p50 for short prompts, 500ms p95 for long prompts during the baseline load. For the pre-load test we can target 20 RPS with the token split shown in sample_prompts.csv.

I've looped in procurement briefly (procurement@acme-analytics.com) — they will follow up on PO timing separately.

Alex
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 12:02:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — hands-on prompt walkthrough + tier mapping

Great — Wed Nov 17, 14:00–17:00 ET locked. Actions we will take before the session:
1) Marissa/Rishi will run a 15-minute synthetic load test on Mon Nov 15 at 16:00 ET against the two candidate models (7B-quant and 13B) and share results in the Drive folder.
2) I'll finalize the agenda and add a 30-minute prompt review block and a 45-minute routing-policy mapping block (model tiers, fallback rules, region priorities). Agenda: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-poc-acme/kickoff_agenda_v1.docx
3) Alex/procurement: please confirm any security/compliance questionnaire items we should pre-fill; otherwise we'll bring baseline SOC2 evidence.

Looking forward — I'll send a calendar invite from cal.com with the confirmed slot and include a short runbook attachment.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: kickoff_agenda_v1.docx (DOCX, 24kb); runbook_stub.txt (TXT, 4kb)
